or kAyasthapaddhati(gAgAbhaTTI) dh. on the Kāyastha Prabhus by Gāgā Bhaṭṭa alias Viśveśvara. One ms. (Baroda 9670) is d. 1671 A. D. [Page369-a.

Bikaner 1760. Bomb. Uni. 1006 (Jātinirṇaya). 1007-08 (inc.). IM. 2985 (inc.). 3382. Rajapur 645 (inc.). Ref. to in Bālambhaṭṭī C. on Mitākṣarā of Vijñāneśvara. See Kane, HDS. I, 457.
Pt.. K. T. Gupte. Rājavāḍyāñcī Gāgābhaṭṭī, Poona, 1919. App. p.. 24-31. (See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. II. p. 362).
--C. by Vaidyanātha Pāyaguṇḍa. Ref. to in Bālambhaṭṭī C. on Mitākṣarā of Vijñāneśvara. See Kane, HDS. I. p. 460.

BORI. 24 of 1912-13. PUL. I. p. 83 (Kāyasthavaṁśavicāra) (29 verses). Rajapur 1020 (20 verses). Q. fully in Parabhūprakaraṇa, a.. composed between 1759 an. 1800 A. D. (BORI. 567 of 1883-84). See Gode, Stud. in Ind. Lit. His.. II. p.. 349-59; the text is edited on p.. 350-53. BISM. has a ms. of this with the title Parabhūkathā (29 verses). For this an. some other mss. also, see Gode. ibid.
